scripts.text: Hey, folks! Here's something you don't see everyday!
scripts.translation: 各位！快來看，這可是難得一見的好東西！

scripts.text: Something you can never find in Rune-Midgarts!
scripts.translation: 在盧恩-米德加爾特絕對找不到第二份！

scripts.text: Something that makes you happy with just one bite!
scripts.translation: 只要嘗一口，就能讓你心情愉快！

scripts.text: It's the perfect dessert and the perfect gift for loved ones.
scripts.translation: 這是最完美的甜點，也是送給心上人的最佳禮物。

scripts.text: High-quality, traditional homemade chocolate only 5000z each!
scripts.translation: 高品質傳統手工巧克力，每份只要5000Z！

scripts.text: I want to wrap the chocolate!
scripts.translation: 我想把巧克力包裝起來！

scripts.text: This chocolate is nothing like others.
Every piece bears the devotion of the person who made it!
scripts.translation: 每一塊都凝聚著製作者的心意！

scripts.text: So, that's why I can't sell more than 5 of them at a time.
scripts.translation: 所以，每次我最多隻能賣5份。

scripts.text: If you really really want more, then talk to me again.
scripts.translation: 如果你真的還想要更多，再來找我吧。

scripts.text: How many do you want anyway?
I'm sure you'll miss this opportunity and regret you didn't buy it.
scripts.translation: 錯過這個機會，你一定會後悔沒買的。

scripts.text: Remember, you can never find this anywhere else!
scripts.translation: 記住，這種東西別處可找不到！

scripts.text: Come back anytime, when you change your mind.
scripts.translation: 改變主意的話，隨時歡迎回來。

scripts.text: I can't sell more than that to the same person.
scripts.translation: 我不能賣給同一個人更多了。

scripts.text: And you know it's not like an everyday meal.
scripts.translation: 而且這又不是日常飯菜。

scripts.text: Eating too much is not really good for you.
Looks like you don't have enough zeny with ya.
Maybe you should borrow some zeny from a friend.
Cuz, I'm not gonna be here everyday.
scripts.translation: 畢竟我可不會天天都在這裡。

scripts.text: It's also perfect as a gift!
You know you can't get this kind of chocolate normally.
scripts.translation: 你知道平時可買不到這種巧克力。

scripts.text: If you want more, you should come back.
scripts.translation: 想要更多的話，就再來找我。

scripts.text: Might be a good idea to buy some more while you have a chance...!
scripts.translation: 趁現在有機會，多買一些或許不錯...！

scripts.text: If you want to gift-wrap the chocolate, of course, you need chocolate, plus, wrapping paper, wrapping strap and a box.
scripts.translation: 當然，要把巧克力包裝成禮物，你需要巧克力、包裝紙、包裝帶和盒子。

scripts.text: You also need to pay 500 zeny to carve your name on the box.
scripts.translation: 還要支付500 Zeny，才能把你的名字刻在盒子上。

scripts.text: Hmm.. Looks like you don't have enough materials to decorate the gift box..
scripts.translation: 嗯...看來你沒有足夠的材料來裝飾禮盒...

scripts.text: You can't just put your gift into some plain looking box..
scripts.translation: 總不能把禮物隨便放進一個普通盒子裡吧...

scripts.text: You need to bring some wrapping paper, wrapping strap, and a box.
scripts.translation: 你得帶來包裝紙、包裝帶和盒子。

scripts.text: Oh, also bring 500 zeny, and don't forget to bring your true loving heart with you!!
scripts.translation: 哦，還要帶500 Zeny，別忘了帶上你真摯的愛心！！

scripts.text: I can't create something right away!
scripts.translation: 我沒法馬上就把東西變出來！

scripts.text: You know I'm not an alchemist or anything.
scripts.translation: 你知道我又不是鍊金術士。

scripts.text: You're not saying that you want an empty chocolate box without any chocolate in it, am I right?
scripts.translation: 你該不會想要一個裡面沒有巧克力的空盒子吧？

scripts.text: It's your chocolate box with your name on it.
scripts.translation: 這是刻著你名字的巧克力禮盒。

scripts.text: See, your name looks great on the box!
scripts.translation: 看，你的名字刻在盒子上真好看！

scripts.text: Valentine's the reason I came back.
scripts.translation: 我回來就是為了情人節。

scripts.text: I'm sure you'll miss this opportunity and regret you didn't buy it.
scripts.translation: 錯過這個機會，你一定會後悔沒買的。

scripts.text: Remember, you can never find this anywhere else!
scripts.translation: 記住，這種東西別處可找不到！

scripts.text: Come back anytime, when you change your mind.
scripts.translation: 改變主意的話，隨時歡迎回來。

scripts.text: I am a Packs Trader, I sell paper boxes and supplies for packing presents.
scripts.translation: 我是包裝材料商，出售紙盒和禮品包裝用品。

scripts.text: Do you have something to buy?
You can't buy more than 10 items at once.
Come back when you need something.
I told you not to buy more than 10...
scripts.translation: 我說過一次不能買超過10件...

scripts.text: Hope it makes your Valentine's Day more pleasing!
scripts.translation: 希望它能讓你的情人節更加愉快！

scripts.text: You can't buy more than 10 items at once.
Come back when you need something.
I told you not to buy more than 10...
scripts.translation: 我說過一次不能買超過10件...

scripts.text: Hope it makes your Valentine's Day more pleasing!
scripts.translation: 希望它能讓你的情人節更加愉快！

scripts.text: You can't buy more than 10 items at once.
Come back when you need something.
I told you not to buy more than 10...
scripts.translation: 我說過一次不能買超過10件...

scripts.text: Hope it makes your Valentine's Day more pleasing!
scripts.translation: 希望它能讓你的情人節更加愉快！

scripts.text: Hello, I only make the Valentine rings to those experienced adventurer Level 75 or above.
scripts.translation: 你好，我只為75級及以上的資深冒險者製作情人節戒指。

scripts.text: Come back when you're experienced enough to handle the quests.
scripts.translation: 等你有足夠經驗完成任務後再來吧。

scripts.text: The box with the ring, carved with your name, is for the one you love.
scripts.translation: 刻有你名字的戒指禮盒，是送給心上人的。

scripts.text: As for the rings that you receive from others, they should all be registered with the Vote Manager.
scripts.translation: 至於收到的戒指，都應該交給投票管理員登記。

scripts.text: She is standing near the Prontera Fountain.
scripts.translation: 她就在普隆德拉噴泉附近。

scripts.text: Only the most popular male and female are subjected to getting rewards.
scripts.translation: 只有最受歡迎的男女冒險者才能獲得獎勵。

scripts.text: Be aware, and always try to stay popular!
Come to me if you're interested in the event, 'Who's Valentine's Hottest?'
scripts.translation: 如果你對‘誰是情人節人氣王？’活動感興趣，就來找我吧。

scripts.text: I make the most precious rings that you can give to your sweethearts.
scripts.translation: 我會製作最珍貴的戒指，讓你送給心上人。

scripts.text: Those rings are very special because I carve your names on them!
scripts.translation: 這些戒指很特別，因為我會把你們的名字刻在上面！

scripts.text: Isn't it such a brilliant idea?
Give these special rings to your sweethearts!
scripts.translation: 把這些特別的戒指送給心上人吧！

scripts.text: You should hurry 'cuz this event will only last for two weeks.
scripts.translation: 快行動吧，活動只持續兩週。

scripts.text: Give that special someone a gift of a Valentine's ring.
scripts.translation: 送給特別的那個人一枚情人節戒指吧。

scripts.text: Remember, you can only generate the ring once.
scripts.translation: 記住，你只能製作一次戒指。

scripts.text: You also need Wrapping Paper, Wrapping Strap and a Box to make the ring.
scripts.translation: 製作戒指還需要包裝紙、包裝帶和盒子。

scripts.text: So you better be sure of who you give this to.
scripts.translation: 所以一定要想清楚要送給誰。

scripts.text: By the way, It costs 1,000 zeny.
scripts.translation: 順便說一下，製作費是1,000 Zeny。

scripts.text: Would you like to make one?
Hmm.. I gotta give it a second thought...
You can't put a rush on such a thing like this.
Think about what you truly want.
Well, you don't have enough materials to make a gift box.
scripts.translation: 嗯，你沒有足夠的材料製作禮盒。

scripts.text: Check what you have, and come back later with all the materials.
scripts.translation: 檢查一下物品，備齊材料後再來。

scripts.text: Here, the most precious ring in the world!
scripts.translation: 給你，這枚世界上最珍貴的戒指！

scripts.text: Don't forget, you can never make this ring again.
scripts.translation: 別忘了，這枚戒指無法再次製作。

scripts.text: You must pick out the one that you really really love, and give this ring to that person.
scripts.translation: 一定要選出你真正深愛的人，把這枚戒指送給對方。

scripts.text: Of course, you've got to get rings from others, that's the way you can participate in the voting, right?
scripts.translation: 當然，你得收到別人送的戒指，才能參加投票，對吧？

scripts.text: Challenge yourself to become Valentine's Hottest!
scripts.translation: 挑戰成為情人節人氣王吧！

scripts.text: Hello, I'm the Valentine's Vote Manager.
scripts.translation: 你好，我是情人節投票管理員。

scripts.text: I'm in charge of collecting rings for this event!
scripts.translation: 我負責收集本次活動的戒指！

scripts.text: I register the rings you get from others and I calculate the total number of rings.
scripts.translation: 我會登記你收到的戒指，並統計總數。

scripts.text: You know what I do besides just counting those rings?
scripts.translation: 你知道除了統計戒指，我還會做什麼嗎？

scripts.text: I can tell you the adventurer's name who's got the most number of votes.
scripts.translation: 我可以告訴你目前票數最高的冒險者是誰。

scripts.text: Plus, you can also find out how many votes he/she got.
scripts.translation: 你也可以檢視他或她獲得了多少票。

scripts.text: Please tell me how many rings you want to register.
scripts.translation: 請告訴我你要登記多少枚戒指。

scripts.text: When you write the number of the rings, the number shouldn't be larger than the number of rings you actually have.
scripts.translation: 輸入的戒指數量不能超過你實際持有的數量。

scripts.text: Seems like the value you entered is too small.
scripts.translation: 你輸入的數量似乎太少了。

scripts.text: I know you've got more. Be honest, dear.
scripts.translation: 我知道你還有更多，誠實點嘛。

scripts.text: Seems like the value you entered is too large.
scripts.translation: 你輸入的數量似乎太多了。

scripts.text: I know you've got less. Be honest, dear.
scripts.translation: 我知道你沒那麼多，誠實點嘛。

scripts.text: I'll take those silver rings, and count the votes for you.
scripts.translation: 我來收下銀戒指並替你統計票數。

scripts.text: Seems like the value you entered is too small.
scripts.translation: 你輸入的數量似乎太少了。

scripts.text: I know you've got more. Be honest, dear.
scripts.translation: 我知道你還有更多，誠實點嘛。

scripts.text: Seems like the value you entered is too large.
scripts.translation: 你輸入的數量似乎太多了。

scripts.text: I know you've got less. Be honest, dear.
scripts.translation: 我知道你沒那麼多，誠實點嘛。

scripts.text: I'll take those gold rings, and count the votes for you.
scripts.translation: 我來收下金戒指並替你統計票數。

scripts.text: You have registered....{0} rings so far.
scripts.translation: 你目前已經登記了...{0}枚戒指。

scripts.text: The current record shows... {0} is the male vote leader who's registered the total of {1} rings.
scripts.translation: 目前記錄顯示...男性票數領先者是{0}，登記了{1}枚戒指。

scripts.text: The current record shows... {0} is the female vote leader who's registered the total of {1} rings.
scripts.translation: 目前記錄顯示...女性票數領先者是{0}，登記了{1}枚戒指。

scripts.text: Hey, you can be popular too!
scripts.translation: 嘿，你也可以成為人氣王！

scripts.text: Though you have to try a lot harder, but still~ Hahaha!
scripts.translation: 不過你得更努力才行~哈哈哈！

scripts.text: Monsieur~! What brings you to my beautiful atelier?
scripts.translation: 先生~！是什麼風把您帶到我美麗的工作室？

scripts.text: What is it that you want?
Well, my sparkling eyes get dried and lose their shine if not for the pretty little lady.
scripts.translation: 唉，要不是有漂亮的小姐，我這雙閃亮的眼睛都要乾澀失去光彩了。

scripts.text: Please leave me alone unless you have business with me.
scripts.translation: 有事再來找我，沒事請別打擾。

scripts.text: This little trifling space felt like heaven the minute you walked in!
scripts.translation: 您一走進來，這小小的地方瞬間就變成了天堂！

scripts.text: Can I help you with anything, if it's alright?
scripts.translation: 如果您不介意，有什麼我能幫忙的嗎？

scripts.text: Don't bother. I'm just passing by.
What can I do to make you
pay a little attention to me?
Please.. I feel like my soul is lost..
scripts.translation: 求求您...我感覺靈魂都迷失了...

scripts.text: I'm not an alchemist, or a magician.
scripts.translation: 我不是鍊金術士，也不是魔法師。

scripts.text: I don't just make chocolate out of anything.
scripts.translation: 我可不會隨便拿點東西就做巧克力。

scripts.text: I always think of making chocolate as artistic work.
scripts.translation: 我一直把製作巧克力當作藝術創作。

scripts.text: You see, I'm no ordinary cook...
scripts.translation: 您看，我可不是普通的廚師...
我製作的巧克力飽含情感...

scripts.text: No one can imitate the looks and the taste.
scripts.translation: 沒人能仿製它的外觀和味道。

scripts.text: Yes, it's nothing like ordinary chocolate!
scripts.translation: 沒錯，它和普通巧克力截然不同！

scripts.text: I'm afraid I can't make it and prove it to you now.
scripts.translation: 可惜我現在沒法做給您看，證明給您看。

scripts.text: I really want to thank you for visiting me and if you only bring ^3152ff3 Chocolates^000000, I'll make you chocolate like you've never seen...
scripts.translation: 真的很感謝您來訪。只要帶來^3152ff3塊巧克力^000000，我就能做出您從未見過的巧克力...

scripts.text: Mademoiselle, with your spirit, I'm sure you can bring 3 pieces of chocolate.
scripts.translation: 小姐，我相信憑您的熱忱，一定能帶來3塊巧克力。

scripts.text: I have no doubt at all.
I could get them myself, but I'm tied up with so much work as you see right now.
scripts.translation: 我本可以自己去買，但您也看到了，我現在工作纏身。

scripts.text: I'll make the best chocolate with the pieces you've brought.
scripts.translation: 我會用您帶來的巧克力製作最棒的成品。

scripts.text: I'm going to put the light of your eyes into this chocolate that no one can resist.
scripts.translation: 我要把您眼中的光彩注入這塊無人能抗拒的巧克力。

scripts.text: It'll be stronger than a sweet sweet love potion.....
scripts.translation: 它的魅力會勝過最甜蜜的愛情靈藥...

scripts.text: Just like the ugly duckling that turned to a beautiful swan-
scripts.translation: 就像醜小鴨變成美麗的天鵝——

scripts.text: Ordinary chocolate pieces are becoming a piece of art!
scripts.translation: 普通的巧克力正變成一件藝術品！

scripts.text: They're getting warm, softly changing the shape, getting stronger again!
scripts.translation: 它們漸漸溫熱，柔和地改變形狀，又變得更結實了！

scripts.text: Oh, is it a master piece or
I can't believe I made this.
scripts.translation: 真不敢相信這是我做出來的。

scripts.text: Oh, I can't take my eyes off..!!
scripts.translation: 啊，我的目光完全移不開了！！

scripts.text: I hope this is just what you wanted, for it bears your beautiful heart inside.
scripts.translation: 希望這正是您想要的，因為裡面承載著您美麗的心意。
